verdict.rationale: Kit documents a fixed email-data retention window: the API returns stats for the last 5 years, but users cannot configure it. Its own API lets users permanently delete draft or scheduled broadcasts, which is a narrow, first-party deletion control. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, deletion of subscriber or account data, bulk or erasure (GDPR-style) workflows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Permanently deletes a draft or scheduled broadcast and returns `204 No Content` on success.
The API returns email stats for the **last 5 years (60 months)**
